race.comment: HIGHLAND SAL (5) drew a squeeze box and was game in defeat when a close second, 1.75 lengths from the winner MR. CHIVES (17.17) at this track. Ran one of the fastest times on the program last start despite finishing in the minors. Top prospect. BEAUTY BEAST (8) had a tough draw to overcome and was game in defeat when only 1.75 lengths from Borroloola Boy in second (19.77) at this track. Strong form has emerged from her last run. Expected to feature. DIM SIM RIXI (1) has shown good improvement at her last two starts, most recently finishing 3rd at Shepparton over 390m. Leading chance. HEAD HUNTER (2) is one of the chances after collecting a minor prize last time.
